_about: Sa'ei's own Google sign-in app (a 'Desktop app' OAuth client). Every copy of Sa'ei uses it for 'Sign in with Google', so users don't create anything in Google Cloud. For a desktop app this ID and secret are not secret: Google's docs say an installed app can't keep them confidential, and what protects the user is the consent screen and the token stored on their own machine. Empty = not set up yet: the Settings page then offers only the App Password route. To use your own client instead, put Google's downloaded file at credentials/gmail_credentials.json; it takes precedence.
